scheme_name: Employability Excellence with College Education & Learning (EXCEL)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student who has completed 12th education.
Open to university students, former pass‑outs, and non‑college‑going youth from the community.
Aadhaar number (Aadhaar card) is mandatory at the time of registration.
benefits_summary: Free training integrated with college education to enhance employability through life skills, communication, and domain‑specific training.
